feature.summary: Shows each attachment before sending as a chip: a thumbnail for images, an icon with kind and size for documents, and a remove control. Web and desktop, phone, VS Code and Chrome have chips; the CLI lists staged items in text. Only the phone opens an image full screen. No app replaces a file in place.

purpose.what_it_does: Lets the person see what is attached, tell files apart, and take one out before the message goes.
purpose.why_it_exists: A person must be sure the right files go to the model and must be able to undo a mistake. Brief items S14.16 to S14.18, S14.22, S14.28 to S14.30.
purpose.who_uses_it: Everyone who attaches files on any app.
problems_solved: Not knowing whether a file is still uploading or ready
Telling several files with similar names apart
use_cases: Drop two pictures on web, see two thumbnails numbered in image-edit mode, remove one.
Phone: tap a picture chip to look at it full screen, then remove it.
CLI: run /attach list to see what is staged, /attach remove 2 to drop one.
VS Code: drag a file in, see its icon and size, press the X.

where_to_find_it: Web and desktop: row of chips above the text box in the composer (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx:5781; apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/AttachmentPreview.tsx).
Phone: horizontal strip labelled 'Attached files' above the input (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/AttachmentPreview.tsx:579).
CLI: '/attach list', '/attach remove [n|all]' and a chip line starting with a paperclip (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:6215-6250, :3278).
VS Code: attachment strip in the sidebar chat (apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/webviewContent.ts:7568).
Chrome: chips in the side panel composer (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts:10416).
prerequisites: At least one file added to the draft.
screens_and_controls: Web image chip: 56 px square thumbnail, tooltip with name and size, a corner X with label 'Remove {name}'; images may carry a number 'Image N' in image-edit or video-reference mode (AttachmentPreview.tsx:188-247).
Web document chip: icon, name shortened to 20 characters, and 'Kind · size' where Kind is PDF, Spreadsheet, Code, Document, Text, Presentation or File (AttachmentPreview.tsx:31-83, :249-295).
Web: after 4 document chips a toggle 'Show all attachments' / 'Show fewer attachments'; images are never hidden (AttachmentPreview.tsx:85-86, :313-380).

Phone image tile 72 px, document tile 96 px wide with icon, name, 'Kind · size'; tap an image to open it full screen (accessibility hint 'Shows the picture full screen'); X labelled 'Remove {name}' (AttachmentPreview.tsx:187-260).
Phone overlays: 'No longer available' when the source file is gone (line 385).
VS Code chip: icon by extension or image thumbnail, name, size (only when the file object is known), x labelled 'Remove attachment {name}' (webviewContent.ts:7544-7627).
Chrome chip: 48 px thumbnail or icon, file name, a status line and an x labelled 'Remove {file}' (side_panel.ts:10416-10470); no size shown.
journey: Check name, kind and size; on phone tap an image to view it.
Press the X (or /attach remove) on any chip to take it out.
Send; removed files are not sent.
feedback_and_outputs: A ready draft chip shows no progress text on web (AttachmentPreview.tsx:138-143 returns nothing for 'ready' or 'complete').
Phone ready chip shows no overlay.
CLI: 'Removed {label}.' or 'Removed N staged image(s).' or 'Nothing staged for the next turn.' (tui_app.rs:943-962, :6223).

working: Web/desktop chips with thumbnails, kind icons, size, remove, collapse and image numbering (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/AttachmentPreview.tsx).
Removal releases the preview URL and frees the file count and byte budget (apps/web/features/chat/hooks/use-attachments.ts:531-547).
Phone chips with thumbnails, kind icons, size, remove and full-screen image view (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/AttachmentPreview.tsx:187-260, :609).
CLI staged list with sizes and removal by number or all (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:6222-6250, :943).
VS Code chips with icon, name, size and remove; removal of a not-yet-acknowledged chip is deferred until the host assigns an id (webviewContent.ts:7594-7612).
Chrome chips with thumbnail or icon, name and remove, which also aborts an upload in flight (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts:10312-10319).
incomplete: Web image chips show size only in a tooltip, not as visible text (AttachmentPreview.tsx:222).
CLI has no thumbnail or icon; files added with /files appear as a path list in /files with no sizes and no per-file remove command was found (apps/cli/src/claude_parity.rs:416-433).

VS Code size is shown only for files with a size known to the page, which is the drag, drop and paste path; picker-added files go through a different message (ChatStateManager.ts:3976-4040) [inferred].
not_available: Replace in place: no app (brief S14.29; no code found).
Preview of a document or full content before sending: all apps.
Image full-screen preview: web, desktop, CLI, VS Code, Chrome (phone only).

established.statement: An attached image shows a small thumbnail in the composer before sending.
Each non-image attachment shows an icon matching its type (PDF, spreadsheet, code, other).
Each attachment shows its name and size before sending.
The composer makes clear when an attachment is ready and the message can be sent.
Each attachment can be removed before sending and a removed file is not sent.
An attached file can be replaced in place keeping its position.
Before sending the user can open an attachment to view it at full size or read its content.
Attachment-ready controls with honest unavailable states.

acceptance_criteria: Each image on web and phone shows a thumbnail; each document shows an icon, name and size.
Pressing X removes exactly that chip; the removed file is absent from the sent message.
On web, with 5 documents attached, 4 show and 'Show all attachments' reveals the fifth; images stay visible.
On the phone, tapping an image chip opens it full screen and closing returns to the draft.
CLI '/attach list' numbers staged items and '/attach remove 1' removes the first.
Chrome and VS Code chips each have a remove control with a name in its accessible label.
inferred: Replace and preview are not required by any decision record found; the brief marks them missing, not built [inferred].
proposed: [proposed] Show size as visible text on web image chips and on Chrome chips.
[proposed] Add a document preview before send, starting with images and text on web.
[proposed] Add 'Replace' to the chip menu on web and phone.

steps.what_happens: A file is admitted and a preview URL is created from the File object.
The chip renders thumbnail or icon, name and size from the File.
Remove revokes the preview URL and removes the file from the lists.
Phone tap on an image opens a local full-screen viewer.
VS Code removal posts removePendingAttachment to the extension host, which deletes the pending file.

corrections.claim: Web: a ready draft chip shows no progress text (AttachmentPreview.tsx:138-143 returns nothing for 'ready' or 'complete').
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Behaviour is right, line is wrong. The ready/complete check is at line 147. Lines 138-143 are the UploadStatus props.
corrections.correction: Cite :147 for the ready/complete early return.

corrections.claim: No attachments: component returns nothing. Web AttachmentPreview.tsx:300; phone :556.
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Web returns null at 320. Phone returns null at 564, and only when there are no attachments and nothing preparing.
corrections.correction: Web :320; phone :564, when attachments and preparing are both empty.

corrections.claim: Local mode: on web, an on-device model shows the conflict banner next to the chips (ChatComposerNew.tsx:5336).
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The banner exists at 5333-5345, with a 'switch to cloud' button. localAttachmentConflict is true whenever a local model is selected and any attachment is present (line 1589). Send is then blocked: the early return at ~3596 (`if (localAttachmentConflict) return;`) stops it. So on web, attachments cannot be sent with an on-device model. The page does not say this.
corrections.correction: On web, attaching any file while an on-device model is selected shows a refusal banner and blocks sending until the person leaves the local model or removes the files.

corrections.claim: Remove while uploading: label becomes 'Cancel upload of {name}' (web :132-136; phone :187-198).
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Web is correct: the label changes for the preparing, uploading and verifying phases (:132-136). Phone builds the label at line 476, not 187-198.

corrections.claim: CLI: '/attach list', '/attach remove [n|all]'; staged label 'path (size)'; messages 'Removed {label}.' / 'Removed N staged image(s).' / 'Nothing staged for the next turn.'
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The commands and messages match (tui_app.rs:6222-6250, :943-962). But the list holds staged images only (staged_images; the error reads 'Not a staged image number'). The label is 'path (size)' or 'path (size, full resolution)' (:871-876). The page implies all attachments are listed. The command also accepts the alias 'rm'.
corrections.correction: /attach list and /attach remove cover staged images only. Labels are 'path (size)' or 'path (size, full resolution)'.

corrections.claim: VS Code removal posts removePendingAttachment to the host, which deletes the pending file; removal of an un-acked chip is deferred (webviewContent.ts:7594-7612; ChatStateManager.ts:2239).
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The post and the deferral are correct (data-remove-requested). The host handler at ChatStateManager.ts:2239 only splices the entry from the in-memory _pendingAttachments list and removes it from in-flight, queued and steering sends. It does not delete a file. The page also labels this step 'device', but it runs in the extension host.
corrections.correction: The host drops the attachment from its pending list and from queued or in-flight sends. It does not delete a file.

missing_facts: On web, an on-device (Local) model refuses attachments entirely. localAttachmentConflict (ChatComposerNew.tsx:1589) blocks send (~:3596) until the person switches to cloud or removes the files. The page mentions only a banner.
The CLI /attach list and /attach remove act on staged images only (tui_app.rs:6222-6250, :943). The CLI also accepts 'rm' as an alias and local file paths, not just images.

The web send path defers send while an attachment is being prepared, via deferredSendRef (ChatComposerNew.tsx:3596-3600). The page ties this only to location-data cleaning, but attachmentPreparing is generic.
